title: Map bookkeeping: one settled line per ticket, out of scope never settled, map done from every path
summary: Resumed after the owner dropped the map screen clause from the fourth criterion. Merged: one settled line per ticket, out-of-scope tickets never settled, updateMap reports map done, read-back retry on map writes, repeatable create and merge.

deferred.what: A merge undone with no decision of its own still reads as a duplicate: merge ticket 2 into 3, reopen 2, close 2 as out of scope, and the tickets screen badge says "Closed · merged into ..."; a plain close gives the settled line "Merged into #3".
deferred.why: The fix needs a decision on what marks a merge as undone, which the memory store does not record today; the criterion covers only a ticket later decided on its own.
